newsitem.title: GERMANY: Europe must reform welfare systems - Ciampi, Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Europe must reform welfare systems - Ciampi, Fazio.

text.p: Financial stability and public welfare are closely linked, and European countries cannot afford to delay reforming their welfare systems any longer, according to Italy's Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi and Bank of Italy Governor, Antonio Fazio.

Ciampi said the issue had been touched on by the G7 countries on Saturday. He stressed that a balanced welfare system taking into account the steep rise in life expectancy in the past few years was "fundamental for financial stability over the long term."

Fazio pointed out that the European economies lagged the U.S. and Japan on this score and that Europe's public expenditure was "10-percent higher than it should be because of inefficient social spending."
